adaptations: Local font URLs; React chrome uses portal sidebar classes and bundled icons. Account and device settings live in the header. Lato font remains OFL licensed; see desktop/assets/lato-OFL.txt.

sidebar.adaptations: Identical vendored assets; React renders semantic buttons in place of portal links. Neural Labs opens in the browser only when connected discovery supplies an eligible destination. Sidebar preferences are per desktop account.

task_taxonomy.adaptations: Identical bundled workspace settings component, CSS and SVG icons. React task forms and cards use the same styles. Local API transport keeps the desktop self-contained.
